comment: The one place the toolchain versions live. Nix, the webOS and Android
cross builds, the Windows scripts and the Actions workflows all read
these fields rather than repeating a version string of their own.
MSVC has no way to build FFmpeg's own configure, so the Windows
static closure takes FFmpeg as an mpv meson subproject from the
GStreamer meson port. That port stops at 8.1.x -- there is no
meson-9.x branch -- so Windows is the one platform that cannot be
on the version above. Move it the moment a 9.x port exists.
